evaluator_state: Draft structured-claim scorer; not a full semantic evaluation.

a_log_check.method: A replay with four rule policies and OracleJudge; generator=None; model network calls blocked.

limits: The A runs use placeholder text. They are code checks, not real model quality or latency results.
Diagnostic Oracle scores are a gold-path check, not a learned policy result.
Scoring uses supplied structured claims and gold values, not full semantic judgments.
Atomic fact extraction, whole-answer scoring, model-based support checks, and bootstrap intervals remain open.
TTFGI uses claim start, not full-fact commitment time; useful-to-question checks remain open.
Value matching can miss negation and wrong relationships in a claim.
Explicit corrections still need review before completion and TTCA can be scored.
A does not log Wait calls or all model errors in its policy log.
A speech timing is estimated, not measured from audio.
